newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end flat, seen opening mixed - SEP 1.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end flat, seen opening mixed - SEP 1.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended flat in dull trading on Sunday when the Karachi bourse reopened after the Friday-Saturday weekend, dealers said.
They said the index was likely to open mixed on Monday's settlement day amid position-squaring and selling pressure.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share price index ended 0.41 points, or 0.03 percent, down at 1,417.83 amid 189 losers and 61 gainers. Volume fell to 10 million from Thursday's 12 million.
Stocks closed slightly below Thursday's level, with solid performances by PTCL and HUBCO offsetting the downward trend, a dealer at Kausar Abbas Bhayani said.
One broker said the thin turnover and falling volumes in PTCL and HUBCO were a matter of concern.
Adamjee Insurance rose 6.00 rupees to 98, Engro 5.00 to 145 and PSO 1.00 to 332. HUBCO added 0.15 to 29.80 and PTCL 0.05 to 36. Siemens fell 21 to 136 and Lever Brothers 5.00 to 670.
